(Asajj Ventress) |homeworld= |birth= |death=During or after [[18 BBY]], an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Cort)|astronomical object]]{{TalesDate|U1}} |species=A [[Unidentified groove-skinned species|species]]{{TOTU|A Way Forward}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{TOTU|A Way Forward}} {{AD|Disney+}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Orange]] |skin=Black |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Jedi Order]]{{InsiderCite|229|Inquisitor Countdown}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Inquisitor]]s *[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Inquisitorius]] |masters=[[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] |apprentices= }} {{Quote|You don't fight like a Jedi.|The Inquisitor, to Asajj Ventress|}} A [[Force-sensitive]] [[Gender|male]] [[Unidentified groove-skinned species|alien]] individual served the [[Galactic Empire]] as an '''Inquisitor'''. At some point the [[Inquisitor]] [[Great Jedi Purge|hunted]] the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Lyco Strata]], who had survived [[Order 66]]. During this hunt, he encountered former [[bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress]], who was protecting Strata, and the Inquisitor dueled Ventress, disarming her and knocking her onto the ground. However, before he could deliver the killing blow, he was stabbed in the back by Strata. The Inquisitor had [[Color|black]], ridged skin. He wore a suit of black body armor and [[cape]], with a crested, visorless [[helmet]] that showed his orange [[eye]]s. The individual wielded a [[double-bladed spinning lightsaber]] with crimson blades. ==Biography== ===Tracking a Padawan=== {{Quote|Too late. He's here.|Lyco Strata|}} The [[Inquisitor]] was once a [[Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order]], an organization of [[Force-sensitive|Force-users]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic]].''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' At some point during or after [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the individual joined the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Inquisitorius]], an organization that [[Jedi hunter|hunted]] Jedi survivors of [[Order 66]]. Like all Inquisitors, he was trained by [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. At some point, he became aware of the [[death]] of [[Asajj Ventress]], former [[assassin]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]] turned [[bounty hunter]].
[[File:AsajjInquisitorApproaches-AWayForward.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The Inquisitor stands in the desert town in front of the landing port. His cape blows in the wind.|The Inquisitor approaches the landing port Asajj Ventress and Lyco Strata went into.]]
The Inquisitor tracked Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Lyco Strata]] to a [[Unidentified desert town|desert town]] on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Cort)|astronomical object]]. There, he witnessed Strata sneak into a landing port along with Ventress, now retired and helping the [[Gender|boy]]{{TOTU|A Way Forward}} {{AD|Disney+}} evade Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s. As Ventress urged Strata to go into hiding, the Padawan overheard [[blaster]]s and a [[lightsaber]] in the distance. He informed Ventress it was too late because the man tracking him had arrived as the doorway into the port exploded. The Inquisitor entered and ignited a single blade of his [[double-bladed spinning lightsaber]]. ===Dueling a former Padawan=== {{Quote|I know who you are. You should've stayed dead.|The Inquisitor, to Asajj Ventress|}} Ventress stood between Strata and the Inquisitor, commanding the Padawan to flee on the boarding [[starship]] while she ignited her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. The two stared each other down as the Inquisitor paced before Ventress charged forward, swinging her [[Curved-hilt lightsaber|blade]]. He blocked her attack and pushed her away. The two exchanged a few more blocks before the Inquisitor knocked Ventress away with a kick to her [[head]]. The two exchanged more swings before the Inquisitor grabbed Ventress's [[Limb|foot]] and flipped the former bounty hunter onto her back. Ventress rolled away to avoid a swing of the Inquisitor's [[Double-bladed lightsaber|lightsaber]] and used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|push]] him away. She leapt after him, but the Inquisitor recovered and caught her mid-air using the Force, tossing her into some boxes. [[File:InquisitorClashAsajjVentress-AWayForward.png|thumb|left|300px|The Inquisitor locks blades with Asajj Ventress.]] As the Inquisitor approached a fallen Ventress, Strata emerged from the starship's [[entry ramp]] and leapt at the Jedi hunter with his [[Lyco Strata's lightsaber|lightsaber]] ignited, only for the Inquisitor to roundhouse kick the boy away. Ventress acquired Strata's loose [[Weapon|lightsaber]] and reengaged the Inquisitors with [[Jar'Kai|both]] lightsabers. The Inquisitor and former assassin evaded and blocked each other's attacks until the Inquisitor pinned Ventress to a box, forcing her to use both sabers to hold back his blade. While pushing against her blades, the Inquisitor remarked how her fighting style did not feel Jedi-like. He then revealed that he recognized who she was and taunted that she should have stayed dead. [[File:InquisitorImpaled-TWF.png|thumb|300px|right|Lyco Strata impaled the Inquisitor from behind using both his and Ventress's lightsabers.]] Ventress broke the stalemate and slashed her lightsaber across the Inquisitor's face, scarring his cheek. The Inquisitor responded by igniting the second blade of his lightsaber. As Ventress charged at the Jedi hunter, he slashed the group to force a dust cloud up and then threw his weapon from behind the veil. The lightsaber spun in the air and returned to the Inquisitor, with Ventress dodging its blades. As the fight continued, the Inquisitor disarmed Ventress of Strata's lightsaber, sliced through a box the former bounty hunter threw at him, and then knocked Ventress back with a powerful blow, disarming her of her own lightsaber. As he approached the prone Ventress, he moved her lightsaber away from her with the Force. As he raised his lightsaber to strike Ventress down, Strata stabbed him in the back with his and Ventress's lightsabers, killing the Inquisitor. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Inquisitor-ToppsChoice2025.png|thumb|250px|left|The Inquisitor had dark skin with orange eyes and wielded a double-bladed spinning lightsaber.]] The Inquisitor was a male [[Unidentified groove-skinned species|alien]]. He had [[Color|black]] skin and orange [[eye]]s. He taunted his enemies in battle, as he did with Ventress during their duel. ==Powers and abilities== He was Force-sensitive and, as a former member of the Jedi Order, was trained to wield the Force. He was capable of lightsaber dueling and wielded a [[double-bladed spinning lightsaber]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|So incredibly excited to join the Star Wars universe and announce that I voice the #Inquisitor in episode one of #StarWars #TalesOfTheUnderworld out on Disney+ now!|Daniel Ross, on voicing the Inquisitor|{{Facebook|username=ActorDanielRoss|url=ActorDanielRoss/posts/1089215473033323|name=[[Daniel Ross]]|date=2025-05-05|quote=So incredibly excited to join the Star Wars universe and announce that I voice the #Inquisitor in episode one of #StarWars #TalesOfTheUnderworld out on Disney+ now! A huge thank you to my friends at Lucasfilm including Lindsay Halper, Athena Portillo, and Dave Filoni for having me, and to my amazing team at CESD Talent Agency! May the force be with you!! #voiceactor #danielross #maythe4thbewithyou #revengeofthe5th #starwarsday|archivedate=20250506151406}}}} The Inquisitor first appeared in "[[A Way Forward]]," the first episode of ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]''. The episode aired [[May 2]], [[2025]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Fortnite]]''{{'s}} "''Star Wars'' Watch Party" event, two days prior to the full series' [[May 4]] premiere on [[Disney+]].{{Fortnite|url=news/get-a-new-stormtrooper-in-fortnite-and-watch-two-episodes-of-star-wars-tales-of-the-underworld|text=Get a New Stormtrooper in Fortnite & Watch Two Episodes of Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld!|date=2025-04-29}} He was voiced by [[Daniel Ross]] and credited as "Inquisitor." The Inquisitor was first pictured in the trailer{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+|date=2025-04-02}} and article announcing ''Tales of the Underworld''.{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''|date=2025-04-02}} The trailer and article were posted on [[April 2]], 2025. Ross expressed his joy at joining the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe through voicing the Inquisitor on social media, calling it an honor.{{YouTube|video=m_iewnhXrQg|text=The voice of the Inquisitor in #starwars #talesoftheunderworld is Daniel Ross! #maythe4thbewithyou|channel=@ActorDanielRoss|name=Daniel Ross|date=2025-05-04|archivedate=20250520110748}} He thanked series caster [[Lindsay Halper]], executive producers [[Athena Yvette Portillo]] and [[Dave Filoni]], and his team at CESD Talent Agency. Ross, who also voiced the [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] character [[Wikipedia:Donald Duck|Donald Duck]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.actordanielross.com|text=Daniel Ross | Emmy Award Winning Actor & Voice Artist|work=[https://www.actordanielross.com Daniel Ross's official site]|archivedate=20250506003358}} jokingly referred to the Inquisitor as "Darth Quackus."{{Twitter|username=ActorDanielRoss|url=status/1920396750340186319|name=[[Daniel Ross]]|date=2025-05-28|quote=Darth Quackus?
